subject.title: fix(feishu): disable ambient proxy inheritance for WebSocket by default

question: Should Feishu WebSocket egress switch from ambient-proxy-by-default to direct-by-default with `OPENCLAW_FEISHU_WS_USE_PROXY=1` opt-in, or should existing proxy inheritance stay until broader Feishu proxy policy lands?
rationale: The patch is small, but it changes an upgrade-sensitive proxy default that affects inbound delivery and operator egress-control expectations; automation cannot choose that product/security boundary.

options.title: Finish Direct Default
options.body: Land this direction only after docs, test cleanup, real transport proof, and explicit maintainer acceptance of the upgrade behavior are in place.

options.title: Preserve Proxy Default
options.body: Keep ambient proxy inheritance as the upgrade default and add an explicit Feishu direct/bypass mode for affected users.

options.title: Pause For Broader Policy
options.body: Hold or close this PR until the broader Feishu HTTP and mixed-proxy policy work defines the permanent channel routing contract.

recommendation.title: Finish Direct Default
recommendation.body: Land this direction only after docs, test cleanup, real transport proof, and explicit maintainer acceptance of the upgrade behavior are in place.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice centers on shared proxy policy and security-sensitive egress defaults, and history ties this handle to the shared ambient proxy helper path.
